## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Verify the oracle report timestamp is within the configured staleness window and submit a fresh report.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let pub1 = Address::generate(&f.env);
let mut pubs = soroban_sdk::Vec::new(&f.env);
pubs.push_back(pub1.clone());
f.client.mock_all_auths().set_oracle_config(&f.governor, &pubs, &1, &3600);
let now = f.env.ledger().timestamp();
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_submit_oracle_time(&pub1, &(now + 4000)));
```

This reproduction is derived from the contract's error surface tests in `error_surface_test.rs`.
